parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerAnalyticsTests.swift`. The near-duplicate signal (Jaccard 0.7) between `AudioEnginePlayerAnalyticsTests.capturesPauseEvent` (line 293) and `AudioEnginePlayerAnalyticsTests.capturesStopEvent` (line 310) reflects the natural structural similarity of two distinct behavioral test cases that each verify a different analytics event (pause vs. stop). Merging or abstracting these test methods would obscure the specific event under test and reduce diagnostic clarity when a test fails. No production code is involved, so no refactor is warranted.
